name: Introduction and overview — Ticonderoga-class Cruiser — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Ticonderoga-class Cruiser
description: Introduction and overview of the Ticonderoga-class Cruiser: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Ticonderoga class — 27 built — was the first class with the Aegis combat system and SPY-1 radar, revolutionizing naval air defense. With 122 vertical-launch cells, Ticonderogas served as air-defense commanders for carrier groups through the Cold War's end and the War on Terror. The last retired in the 2020s. Baseline facts: U.S. Aegis cruiser; 27 built; first Aegis/SPY-1 ships; 122 VLS cells..
